item.title: Going first gets the reveal too
item.summary: In a 1v1 game, your friend's photo now develops on Home the first time you see it, even when you posted first and theirs came in hours later.
item.details: If it came in after you went to bed, it's the first thing on Home the next morning; close it and today's card is there. The notification says "They're in too." Your friend never learns when you looked. Available in the latest app version.
